Mail screen + opening letter: for each of 64 mails with the received bit (flags&1) it writes order[count-1-(flags>>2)] = mail index, i.e. rebuilds the newest-first list order from the receive sequence number stored in flags bits 2..7.
Mail list: sets view->items[slot]->+2 to 1 or 0 from the read bit (flags&2) of the given mail; called per list row.
Mail list: copies the 32-byte subject string of a mail (table at 0x8017F860, terminated by >) into list row slot of the view (stride 34 at view+0x447) with x=0x40, y=0x30 header bytes.

Mail screen constructor: allocates the 0x96C view (D_80180860), allocates a kind-0 UiObj whose ctor/update/destroy are 0x80096944/0x80096FFC/0x80097930, then copies 64 VRAM tiles with MoveImage to 960..1022 x 128/152 and DrawSync.

Mail screen + opening letter: for each unreceived mail tests its (type,arg) condition (rank >= arg, story flag bits at 0x801F3788, or mail 18 special case) and marks it received with sequence number count++; mode 1 with pad 0xC delivers all.
Mail list update: on button 0x40 marks the selected mail read and opens it (letter reader), on 0x20 plays the cancel sound and closes; both retire the five list objects and kill obj id 3.

Mail screen update after ctor (set by 0x80096944): once obj id 3 is gone and the busy byte is clear, runs mail_check_new_arrivals + 0x800968C4 + mail_build_order, counts list entries into view->n, clamps rows to 5 and the selection, draws the frame (0x8005BA2C), plays a sound and moves to 0x800972A0.

Mail list update after mail_list_open: waits for the frame drawer (0x8005BA2C) and 0x800517C8, sets two 9-entry s16 tables, then per visible row creates the read mark (0x8005CAE0, mail_set_row_read_mark), the subject text object (mail_copy_subject_to_row + 0x8005CB94, light 20 read / 12 unread) and a row frame; then hands over to mail_list_input.
Ran on selecting/exiting rank 5/10; on confirm/cancel (trig&0x60) plays a key, closes windows 4/6/8/10, kills objects 3/5/7/9 and sets update to 0x800B3FFC.
Ran on selecting rank 5/10; draws the selected rank entry (page+row at +0x98/+0x99) from the table at 0x8017F584, extra path when the row kind is 0xF (player), then update = rank_detail_wait_close.
Ran on ranking/system/load screens; fills points of 15 built-in rows from 0x80049E74, the player row from 0x80049E70, copies 16 x 0x10 rows to 0x8017F584 and bubble-sorts them by points descending.
Ran on system/create/load screens; calls rank_build_table and returns the 1-based place of the row whose kind byte is 0xF (the player), 0 if none.

Ran on ranking and rank select/exit; for 6 rows from the scroll position (+0x99) prints place and points, kills and recreates the three row text objects at 0x8017F684, and shows the up/down arrows (+0x88/+0x8C) by scroll limits.

Ran on ranking; allocates the ranking UiObj (ctor itself, update 0x800B26C8), opens windows, resets the row object arrays to g_ui_none, builds and sorts the rank table, clears 0x801A2574, returns the object.
Ran on swap head / yes load; once per block (flag bit 0), adds the block data address to words +0x00/+0x08/+0x10 of each 0x1C-byte entry (offset-to-pointer relocation of a loaded file).

Ran on ranking and rank select/exit; per frame redraws rows, scrolls the cursor (+0x98) and page (+0x99) on pad up/down with key repeat, on confirm opens the selected entry's detail (func_800B2F18, update 0x800B2F74), on cancel closes the screen (update 0x800B2EC4).

Ran on AC test / check performance; soft-float a / b on two doubles: exponent difference + 1022, restoring division of 53-bit mantissas with func_800B61D0 compare, func_800B6850 negate and shifts, rounding, overflow error 34/15; sibling of the matched add (0x800B59F4) and multiply (0x800B68C4).

Ran on AC test / check performance; for AC record arg0 (0x800411F4 + arg0*0x39C) sums weights/stats of the equipped parts (part ids at 0x80031A58..0x80031A63, per-type tables at 0x800B9xxx/0x800BAxxx), caps by the legs' max load and derives figures with the soft-float double helpers (add/mul/div, __fixunsdfsi); not attempted (25504 bytes).
ran on slot 1/system/create/load; writes n clamped to +-9999999 right-aligned in 8 chars with blanks and a leading minus (8-digit twin of 0x80074E44).
ran on slot 1; once func_8005BA2C box is gone prints the save (kind S) or load header and slot texts, calls 80051C44 for L/R arrows, 80053E98, then update=800542F0.

kind S confirm box set by 800542F0; ran on NEW / yes create new data; card check 800685A8(slot) aborts with error box, else mode 0 opens three option boxes and goes to 80054C34, mode 1 back to 800542F0.
ran on selecting save slot 1 / yes load; same body as 80054AB0 but next state 800550A0.
ran on yes create new data; stores 800684A0(slot) in status[slot], on error shows message + key-on sound, else 80066F90(slot, entry) and shows done/fail message, update=ui_obj_nop2.
ran on system; ui_obj_alloc(0) ctor/destroy setup, kind S when owner ctor is 8004FDF4, L for 800A2D0C or a non-null 2nd arg, else error box; sets D_801A2574=2, returns the object.

ran on slot 1; checks the card (800684A0), reloads its directory (80066994, 80066CB0), flags +0xA7 when saving with fewer than 15 used blocks in D_801EF6D0[slot], resets cursor/top and picks the next state from used/+0x08.

ran on slot 1; draws up to 5 row frames, then per visible card entry (0x2C records at 0x801F5098 from top +0xA6) the number, name, an s16 value and an 8-digit value (func_80051A74), plus the NEW DATA row when +0xA7 is set.

ran on yes load; card check, then 80067CF0(slot, entry) reads the save, copies the 0xA0-byte block 0x80031A94 to 0x80042AA8, rebuilds state (80083A58, 80074A18, 8005EB80, 80073B7C), waits on 800517C8, fixes VRAM with MoveImage, and shows the loaded/failed message.

ran on system / yes create / yes load; prints the pilot and AC names from 0x80031BD4, credits (D_80039CA4, 8 digits), rank (800B203C), missions/successes/failures from 0x80041B3C/40/44 with success and failure percentages, and a completion percentage from 11 part flags in the two 0xA0 blocks at 0x80031A94; update=80052BD0.

ran on system / save data / load data / exiting to general menu; pad up/down (0x1000/0x4000, with repeat delay/rate from D_801A2574) moves the 5-entry cursor +0xA1, cancel 0x20 closes the boxes (update 80055C2C), confirm 0x40 sets kind S/L and D/E then update 80052F68, entry 4 exits via 8005700C.

ran on NEW / selecting save slot 1 / slot 1; creates the up/down scroll arrows (+0x90/+0x94), shows them by top +0xA6 vs the entry count, moves the row cursor +0xA2 with pad repeat and scrolls via 80053E98, cancel goes to 8005489C, confirm opens the save (S: 80054AB0) or load (80054F1C) / new-data (80055580) confirm box.

ran on load data / save data / slot 1; polls card slot 0/1 on alternate frames (800685A8) to light the slot icons, up/down moves +0xA0, confirm checks the card (800684A0, 3 retries) and opens the slot (80053924) or a card error box, cancel returns to the caller menu.
Runs on every garage/menu screen; singleton UiObj (ctor=self) that resets four light MATRIX globals 0x800B8F24/84/A4/9024 and installs update 0x8005CDEC which ramps the light colour up to 0x180.
Assembly (swap/cancel head); copies a 4-corner quad, insets it by 8 px and draws six 8-px edge strips from texture u=192..216 v=208 via func_800646AC, then calls func_8006035C.
Assembly (swap/cancel head, check performance); same 4-corner quad as 0x80061164, draws eight 8x8 tiles (u/v 192..216) of a 9-slice window frame via func_800646AC.

Ran on yes-load; for each part slot whose byte in D_80031A58[] is 0xFF asks func_8007AA04(slot) for an id and loads it with func_80050AF4/func_80051450 (offset by D_80039CA2), optional func_80074A18 when flag set.

Assembly/paint screens; takes TMD model D_801F36D0[mi] object oi (0x1C entry), sets rot/trans matrix, RTPS all vertices into sxy/sz tables, then dispatches each primitive packet through handler table D_800B7048[type].

TMD primitive handler from table D_800B7048 (assembly/paint screens); per packet builds a closed flat polyline (code 0x4C, 4 points + 0x55555555) from the 3 projected vertices, NCCS colour, AVSZ3 depth, addPrim into the OT.
TMD primitive handler (table D_800B7048), 20-byte quad packets; draws a quad wireframe as a closed LINE polyline (0x4C) plus a LINE_F2 (0x40) diagonal, NCCS colour, AVSZ3 depth.
Same body as 0x8005A3A4 for 32-byte quad packets (vertex indices at +0x16..+0x1C); wireframe quad handler.
Same body as 0x8005A3A4 for 36-byte quad packets (vertex indices at +0x16 stride 4, i.e. gouraud normal/vertex pairs); wireframe quad handler.
Assembly screen; TMD primitive handler over 16-byte packets at D_8017E500: NCLIP backface cull, NCCS-lit flat triangle (POLY_F3, tag 0x04FFFFFF), AVSZ3 depth, addPrim into the OT.

Assembly screen; TMD primitive handler over 28-byte packets at D_8017E500: NCLIP cull, NCCT lighting of 3 normals into a gouraud textured triangle (POLY_GT3, uv/clut/tpage copied), AVSZ3 depth, addPrim.

TMD primitive handler over 32-byte packets at D_8017E500 (ran on garage/mail/ranking screens): NCLIP cull, NCCS-lit flat textured quad (POLY_FT4, tag 0x09533900, uv/clut/tpage copied), AVSZ3 depth, addPrim.

Garage main menu (6-item ring, ran on garage/mail/ranking/system screens): on confirm runs the front item setup (switch on ring.front, e.g. AC data copy for item 0), then ranks the other panels and switches to func_8004EC24; left/right start a turn via func_8004E894 and reset the light matrices.
ran on opening letter; resets work->line[i] (text "@0>" colour codes, read pos/len/flags)
twin of 0x8009795C for the second line array at work+0x264
mail/opening letter; allocs a kind-4 UiObj (render_type 3, res 0x800B8CDC) at y=(D_8017F795-D_8017F796)*24, update 0x800998B4
opening letter; allocs kind-6 UiObj, builds 2 text labels (func_8005CB94) from work->line[i].text at y=i*16+5 and resets each line
opening letter; copies src text up to > or / into work+0x520, frees src (free2), clears work+0x0A
opening letter; switch on volatile work->tim_slot (+0x0B, 1..3) loads the TIM via 0x80097FDC to VRAM 896/960 with CLUT row 481..483, clears the slot, DrawSync(0), free2
TIM chain loader: while word==0x10, LoadImage the CLUT (flag bit 3) at (cx,cy) and the image at (x,y); called only by 0x800980E4

opening letter; update of the 0x80097B4C object: src = work text + sum of line[].next, unless a dialog (0x8005BA2C) is up types the first unfinished line via 0x80097A08 (fast while pad 0x40/0x1000/0x4000 held), on new 0x20 press closes (kills obj id 11, opens 0x8005C2D0) and switches update to 0x80097EE8
opening letter; copies one source char (two for @ ^ { escapes) into line->text and appends ">" cursor; "

opening letter; allocs kind-6 UiObj, 5 labels from work->line2[i] (y=i*16+5), resets letter state, clears work text buffers, requests the letter body message (row[order[sel]].id[...] + 819) through 0x800513F0 with callback 0x80097F30, clears VRAM 896/960 pages and CLUT rows 481..483

opening letter; line2 twin of 0x80097A08 plus %N escapes (advance work->unk9, request reply message row[order[sel]].reply[unk9]+819 via 0x800513F0 after waiting on volatile tim_slot, mark seen[N%3] and store 0x8009A218() at work+0x80); plays SsUtKeyOn click after each typed step

mail screen; update of the 0x800997C8 cursor: up/down (pad 0x1000/0x4000 new press) moves sel with wrap, moves cursor y by 24 or scrolls the row names/icons/labels via 0x80099868 and refills the new row (0x8009720C/0x800971AC), then handles the held-key repeat counters 0x800B8CC8/0x800B8CCC

opening letter; update of the 0x80098550 object: scrolls line2[] up/down (unk4/unk5 step counters, history of offsets at +0x10), types the next line via 0x80098268 (fast while 0x40/0x1000/0x4000 held), up/down/advance keys page the letter and request message ids, 0x20 closes back to the list (kills/creates buttons), 0x8/0x4 page the reply TIMs via 0x800980E4
Ran on every save/load slot screen; loops TestEvent over the 4 events at 0x8017E5B4..C0 and returns which fired (0..3); waited on after _card_info/_card_load.
Twin of memcard_wait_sw_event over the 4 events at 0x8017E5C4..D0; waited on after _card_clear (PsyQ _card_event_x pattern), ran on slot 1.
Ran on edit emblem; allocates a kind-4 UiObj (update 0x8007046C) at the position of the object at o+0x98 and stores o in its +0x7C.

Ran on draw red line; converts cursor screen pos (o+0x98 +0x7E/+0x80, minus 172/36, / zoom at +0x84) plus view origin into a pixel and writes the pen color (+0x86) as a 4bpp nibble into the 64-px-wide canvas at +0x88.
Ran on slot 1/create/load; PsyQ card-check sequence: _card_info, on new card _card_clear + _card_load, returns 0..4 status from the event waits; arg = port (chan = port?16:0).
Ran on apply / yes apply; on answer 0 (+0xC4) restores VRAM rects, kills dialog objects 3/5/7/9, sets flag 0x20 in 0x801A2550 and moves on to 0x8006B1E8; answer 1 returns to the editor 0x80068FBC.
Ran on sample / sel purple cat; draws the 4x4 grid of sample emblems (table 0x800B7EE0, 12-byte entries) at 0x44 px spacing, scrolled by the u16 at +0xC8.

Ran on draw/edit/circle-menu screens; per-frame editor step: calls 0x8006D1D8, Circle edge (pad 0x20) opens the menu boxes and switches to 0x80068E14, pad 0x80 edge picks the pen color into 0x8017E618 and switches to 0x8006B250, then 0x8006BA08.

Ran on load yes / sel purple cat; on answer 0 copies the chosen sample (index col+page*4+row*4) image and CLUT from VRAM into the canvas (+0x88) and the 15-entry palette 0x8017E5D8 (5:5:5 to 8-bit, alpha 0x60), closes the dialogs.

Ran on edit emblem; reads the canvas image and CLUT back from VRAM, rebuilds the 8-bit palette 0x8017E5D8 (entry 0 black, alpha 0x60), re-encodes it to 5:5:5 with the STP bit for pure black and uploads CLUT and image again, then 0x8006F55C.

Ran on slot 1; firstfile/nextfile over "bu00:BASCUS-94182*" (or bu10), skips names with Z at [12], reads the first 0x280 bytes of each save into a 0xE80 buffer and fills up to 16 0x2C slot entries at 0x801F5098 (36-byte title, +0x24, +0x28), count into 0x801A257C.

Ran on slot 1 / yes create new data; for a port fills the 0x88C card directory at 0x801EF6D0[port]: this game's saves (BASCUS-94182*, skipping Z at [12]) and every file (bu00:*) with names and 8 KB block counts, plus the used-block total.

Ran on circle-to-see-menu/sample/apply; Up/Down (pad 0x1000/0x4000, with auto-repeat delays) move the menu cursor +0x90 over 6 items (ZOOM UNDO CLEAR SAMPLE APPLY CANCEL), Circle closes the menu, Cross runs the item (zoom box, undo 0x8006F590, clear canvas 0x800 bytes, sample list, apply/cancel confirm).

Ran on yes load; checks the card, opens bu00:BASCUS-94182<letter> for the chosen slot with 3 retries, reads the 0xE80-byte save, verifies the checksum of +0x230.., copies the game state blocks to their RAM homes, uploads the emblem image/CLUT (+0x438/+0xC38) to VRAM and re-inits subsystems; returns 1 on success.

Ran on sample / sel purple cat; per-frame sample picker: redraws the 4x4 grid (emblem_sample_draw_grid), d-pad moves col +0xC6 / row +0xC7 / page +0xC5 with auto-repeat, pad 0x8/0x4 switch bank +0xCA, Cross asks to load (msg 0x8004B7C4 -> emblem_sample_load_confirm), Circle backs out.

Ran on draw/edit/menu screens; editor pad handling: Cross held at the canvas edge scrolls the view (+0x7C/+0x7E of view obj, limit 32/48 by zoom), Triangle picks the color under the pen (0x8006C4C0), pad 0x2/0x1 cycle color 0..15, Select cycles zoom 2/4/8 recentring the view, pad 0x8/0x4 cycle tool +0x8C 0..6.

Ran on draw/edit/menu screens; per-frame editor step: unless tool +0x8C is 6, moves the pen cursor with the d-pad (8 px outside the canvas, zoom-sized steps with a repeat counter 0x800B812C inside), clamps it to the 128x128 canvas at 172,36, spawns/kills edge arrows (0x8006FE58), then dispatches the tool handler and calls emblem_edit_input.

Ran on yes create new data; builds the 0xE80-byte save (SC header, SJIS title with slot number, pilot name and a 3-digit counter, per-letter icon, game state blocks, emblem image/CLUT from VRAM, checksum), picks a free letter A..O for a new slot, creates/opens bu00:BASCUS-94182<letter>, writes with retries and reads it back to verify.

assembly/garage/swap head; returns base[cat] + n from a local table of 10 cumulative offsets (0,10,13,..,127): global part number of the n-th part of category cat; 80083A58 indexes the owned-part bytes 0x80042AA8 with it
check performance; called 14x from 0x80085640; writes val as a fixed-width decimal of n digits into buf, clamped to 10^n-1, leading blanks, last digit always shown, a minus sign put on the last blank
